parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own GroupMe destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-groupme_msg` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `groupme://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two Apprise channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. Two transformer channels skip Apprise entirely and, composing your GroupMe bot post URL from your stored secrets, POST a native GroupMe `{bot_id, text}` payload directly: the free `gateway` channel delivers direct to the GroupMe bot post API, and the `gateway-plus` channel adds extra per-enrollment GroupMe destinations at $0.001 per message.

parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment GroupMe destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to GroupMe bot post API (no Apprise)
